message.content: {"version":"1","text":"Your outfit is a striking chocolate brown blazer paired with matching trousers, accented by emerald green boots and a gold flower bracelet.","how_to_wear":["The boots are designed to be worn on the feet only, not as footwear accessories.","The jacket features lapels that frame your shoulders elegantly.","The bracelet sits comfortably on your wrist when arms are crossed or held naturally."],"wrong_photos":[3,4,6,7,8],"swap":{"item":"#37·38","why":"bag - colour","to":""},"named":[{"n":"#59·11","what":"blazer","n":"#26·19","what":"trousers","n":"#406·31","what":"bracelet","n":"#420·09","what":"boots"}],"about_items":[{"n":"#59·11","text":"This chocolate brown blazer features a structured fit with lapels that accentuate your shoulders."},{"n":"#26·19","text":"The trousers in matching chocolate brown offer a tailored silhouette that complements the jacket."},{"n":"#406·31","text":"The gold flower bracelet adds a touch of elegance with its intricate floral design."},{"n":"#420·09","text":"Emerald green suede boots provide a vibrant contrast to the chocolate tones, enhancing your overall look."}]}
